result.summary: Re-gate of commit d2fa122 only (follow-up to the original Step 02b PASS in step-02b-reviewer.json, invalidated by TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR's Step 3b finding that en-US rendered 12h AM/PM instead of the design's 24-hour spec). Read `git show d2fa122` directly: touches only apps/bot/src/i18n/formatTimeInTimezone.ts (+hourCycle: "h23"), apps/bot/src/i18n/formatTimeInTimezone.test.ts (24h/no-AM-PM assertions for en and ru), apps/bot/src/domain/event.test.ts (fixed agenda-line fixtures that had assumed 12h format), and its own handoff record -- nothing outside apps/bot/** + handoffs/, no unrelated changes. Verified against docs/agents/design/REQ-017.md lines 244 and 423: the data-mapping table and worked example both specify 24-hour wall-clock output literally (e.g. 'Oct 1, 2026, 18:00'), so hourCycle: 'h23' is the correct, minimal fix -- a single added option, no restructuring. Independently ran the formatter in node against Asia/Tashkent for en-US and ru-RU at four instants including the two known hourCycle footguns: midnight-local produced '00:00' (not '24:00', which is what hourCycle:'h24' would have produced -- confirms 'h23' was the correct choice, not merely 'a' 24-hour option) and noon-local produced '12:00' correctly for both locales; 18:00 and other times also correct. This directly confirms the fix is semantically sound, not just passing its own tests. Updated tests actually assert what they claim: formatTimeInTimezone.test.ts now checks .toContain('18:00')/.not.toContain('PM')/.not.toContain('AM') (en) and .not.toMatch(/[AP]M/i) (ru) -- these would have failed against the pre-fix code (which rendered '06:00 PM' for en-US), so the regression is now locked down for both locales, closing exactly the blind spot the original cross-TZ check missed (byte-identical output across TZ env vars never varies locale, so it couldn't catch a locale-specific AM/PM defect). event.test.ts's agenda-line fixture updated to 24h ('17:30', '19:30') consistent with the same fix. No now()/current_timestamp introduced (pure formatting change, no DB access). No domain logic added inside a handler (change is confined to the i18n formatter and its tests). No migration in this diff. Independently re-ran npm run lint (0 errors, 2 pre-existing unrelated apps/web warnings), npm run build (both apps/web and apps/bot build clean, tsc passes), and npx vitest run (8 files, 102/102 tests passed, up from 101 -- the +1 is the new ru-locale assertion).
result.next_action: Route to SECURITY-REVIEWER for a re-gate before returning to TEST-DESIGNER -- this is a formatting-only diff (no personal data, consent, authorization, token, or export surface touched) but it lands in apps/bot/**, and the security gate is mandatory on any apps/bot/** change per WF-02 routing regardless of diff size.
